payload.explanation: Keep the familiar Super+Shift+A shortcut while opening the already-installed desktop application instead of a browser web app.

steps: Confirm the desktop application and its chatgpt launcher are installed; do not infer installation from this record.
Back up the user Hyprland bindings configuration. Use the current Omarchy binding helpers to override the existing Super+Shift+A action with chatgpt, avoiding a duplicate binding.
Reload the compositor configuration, check for configuration errors, and test the shortcut.

payload.effects: Super+Shift+A targets the installed desktop application. Other shortcuts and the application installation are unchanged.
payload.rollback: Remove the custom ChatGPT unbind/override entries and reload Hyprland so the packaged web-app binding applies again.
payload.validation_plan: Preserve the previous setting, apply only after approval, then perform the final check in the procedure on the actual system.

activation.details: Apply the setting and perform its documented local check; this record does not execute it.
